workspace.text:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00

Please read Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for them too. Or if you can, tell me their free times and I'll find the overlap.

- Tuesday: 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday: 13:00-14:00
- Thursday: 09:30-10:00, 14:30-15:30
- Friday: 15:00-16:00

**Your slots (Priya + Marcus):**
- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

There appears to be no overlap between these two sets. Could you double-check Priya and Marcus's calendars to see if they might be free during any of Elena and David's free times listed above? Specifically:
- Monday 11:00-12:00
- Tuesday 09:00-10:00
- Wednesday 13:00-14:00
- Thursday 09:30-10:00 or 14:30-15:30
- Friday 15:00-16:00

If none of these work for Priya and Marcus either, then we may have an infeasible scheduling problem.
